part: A, Shift where the check freed pins, the list's lifted and held, each turn ended as a drag

functions.does: The four-speed sequential gearbox at the back: rocking the round + / - knob between the front seats left and right turns the rod p385 running back to a 4 tooth knob gear, which turns the changeover rotary catch one step, moving the driving rings to the next gear up or down.

stopsJudged.why: a travel of 0.2 rad or less each way, stopped at +0.174 rad (641/642); -0.105 rad (648/714)

byHand.why: the '+ -' inset on page 490 shows the round knob between the seats turned both ways with a curved arrow spanning roughly a half turn, to step the sequential gearbox, far more than the viewer's 0.10-0.17 rad.
